description: This PHP source file defines a REST API endpoint class EmpEmergencyContactAPI within the OrangeHRM HRM system. The class provides CRUD operations (list, create, retrieve, update, delete) for managing employee emergency contact information, including validation rules, API documentation annotations, and integration with underlying services and models.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactAPI
classes.description: Defines a REST API for managing employee emergency contacts with CRUD operations, validation, and API documentation annotations within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: getEmpEmergencyContactService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the EmpEmergencyContactService instance used for emergency contact operations.

methods.name: setEmpEmergencyContactService
methods.description: Sets the EmpEmergencyContactService instance for dependency injection.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all emergency contacts for an employee, applying search filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method, including employee number and search filters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new emergency contact for an employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating an emergency contact, including required fields and max lengths.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules for request body parameters used in create and update operations.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove emergency contacts by sequence numbers for an employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete operation, particularly IDs and employee number.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific emergency contact by ID for an employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a specific emergency contact.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing emergency contact for an employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an emergency contact.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Shared logic for creating or updating an emergency contact, handling retrieval or creation of model object, setting attributes, and persistence.
